title: "&#128214; Guestbook &#128214;"
pagetitle: "Guestbook"
description-meta: "Sign the guestbook — say hello to M. Fatih Kara, in the spirit of 1998."
# No `comments:` block, and no Quarto giscus integration. Quarto's loader
# ends with
#
#     document.getElementById("quarto-content").appendChild(script);
#
# and `theme: none` means Quarto emits no #quarto-content wrapper, so that
# line threw "Cannot read properties of null" and the widget never loaded at
# all. The script below is the same thing, anchored where it is written.
#
# It also drops Quarto's light/dark switch, which keyed off a `quarto-dark`
# body class this site does not have — it was handing giscus the same theme
# for both cases. assets/geocities/geocities.js switches the theme instead,
# by postMessage, when the visitor changes neighborhood.
---

::: gc-box
**Thanks for stopping by!!** &#128075;

The book is open &#8212; scroll down, write something, and it appears on this
page straight away. Entries are kept as
[discussions in this site's own repository](https://github.com/karamehmetfatih/karamehmetfatih.github.io/discussions),
so signing needs a GitHub account; you can react to other people's entries with
one click.

**No GitHub?** Say hi on
**[Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/mfkara.net)** or
**[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/m-f-kara)**, or use the
**[contact form on the home page](/#contact)** &mdash; that one reaches my
inbox directly.
:::

## &#9997;&#65039; Sign the book

<p class="blink gc-center">&#9733; Scroll down to the box and leave your mark! &#9733;</p>

Anything is welcome: hello from a fellow plant pathologist, a question about
[LsRTDv1](/lsrtdv1/), a complaint about the blinking text. I read every entry.
